_comment: DEFINICE OTÁZEK = pole 'questions' v API callu. Toto je ZPŮSOB hodnocení. Ukazuje všechna tři primitiva nad stejným vstupem. Klíče (negative_emotion, ...) si volíš ty — pod nimi přijdou odpovědi. Modelu se NEPOSÍLAJÍ, takže celý význam musí být v instructions.

negative_emotion.instructions: Does this text express negative emotion toward the company or its service?

criteria.true: The author expresses dissatisfaction, anger, frustration, or disappointment
criteria.false: The author is neutral, factual, or positive

sentiment_category.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of this text toward the company?

criteria.neutral: Purely factual with no evaluative stance
criteria.mixed: Contains both clearly positive and clearly negative evaluations

anger_level.instructions: How angry is the author of this text?
criteria: Completely calm, no irritation at all
